name: cyclofocus
description: A self-hosted minimalist productivity focus app

scripts.version:bump:patch: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && npm run sync-versions
scripts.version:bump:minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && npm run sync-versions
scripts.version:bump:major: npm version major --no-git-tag-version && npm run sync-versions
scripts.sync-versions: node -e "const v=require('./package.json').version; const fs=require('fs'); ['client','server'].forEach(d=>{const p='./'+d+'/package.json'; const pkg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p)); pkg.version=v; fs.writeFileSync(p,JSON.stringify(pkg,null,2)+'\n');})"
